mapper.sql: c.course_id, c.course_name, c.coach_id, c.course_time, c.duration, c.max_capacity, c.booked_count, c.status, c.remark, h.coach_name AS coach_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM course c LEFT JOIN coach h ON c.coach_id = h.coach_id ORDER BY c.course_time DESC
SELECT FROM course c LEFT JOIN coach h ON c.coach_id = h.coach_id WHERE c.course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course(course_name, coach_id, course_time, duration, max_capacity, booked_count, status, remark) VALUES(#{courseName}, #{coachId}, #{courseTime}, #{duration}, #{maxCapacity}, #{bookedCount}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET course_name = #{courseName}, coach_id = #{coachId}, course_time = #{courseTime}, duration = #{duration}, max_capacity = #{maxCapacity}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} WHERE course_id = #{courseId}
UPDATE course SET booked_count = booked_count + 1 WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1 AND booked_count < max_capacity
